text.tspan: Speculative decoding: guess cheaply, check in one pass
ONE forward pass checks all 4 guesses together
costs about the same as making 1 token (memory-bound)
A wrong guess costs nothing extra: the big model's own token is used instead. Same output quality, only faster.
Works best when the text is predictable: code, JSON, repeated phrases.
